item.title: Find a way to make up a missed lab
item.context_text: You missed a class experiment. Your partner cannot attend the usual catch-up slot.
item.objective_text: Arrange a safe replacement session and keep your project on schedule.
success_conditions: Arrange a safe replacement session and keep your project on schedule.

children.title: Read the lab note
children.instructions: Read closely and use the details to answer.
children.prompt_text: Missed experiments can be repeated on Tuesday or Thursday at four. A teacher must be present. Bring the yellow handout. Reports are due on Monday.

questions.explanation: The lab note specifies the yellow handout.

questions.prompt: Can learners repeat the experiment without a teacher?

children.title: Hear your partner’s message
children.instructions: Listen twice. First identify the update, then check the details you need.
children.prompt_text: I work on Tuesday, but I can get to the school by three fifty on Thursday. I left my handout with Mo. Ask if we need to bring our own laptop for the report.

questions.explanation: They work on Tuesday and are available on Thursday.

children.title: Call the teacher
children.prompt_text: The teacher asks why you want the Thursday slot.
children.instructions: Request the slot and confirm a teacher will be there. Ask about a laptop.
children.goal: Give an actionable response to what you just learned.
children.model_answer: Could we use the Thursday session at four? My partner works on Tuesday. Will a teacher be there, and do we need to bring a laptop?

children.title: Send a plan to your partner
children.prompt_text: The teacher has confirmed Thursday. Laptops can be borrowed at school.
children.instructions: Write where your partner should go first, what to collect, and when the report is due. Remind them of the session time.
children.goal: Arrange a safe replacement session and keep your project on schedule.
children.model_answer: Hi! Thursday at four is confirmed. Please pick up the yellow handout from Mo before you come to the lab. We can borrow a laptop at school. The report is due on Monday, so let’s leave time on Friday to write it together.
